steps.what: Participate in community activities and represent the funeral home through personal engagement

tasks.design: Retain personal participation and community conversations. An event entry in {CALENDAR} supports attendance without replacing the relationship work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Community trust develops through direct participation.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital promotion does not establish a substitute for the stated activity.
tasks.still_hard: Represent services sensitively in a community setting.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, contribute and respond to people without pressuring them.
tasks.altitude: Community engagement time and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Direct community participation is relationship work; no administrative production baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is attending and participating in activities, excluding separate event administration and promotional material production.
The arranger learns participants' concerns through dialogue in s1; no structured contact-interest or consent flag is assumed.
Existing calendar and service information suffice; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no additional workflow or tool is introduced.
unknowns: Community activities and expectations of participation
research_questions: Which activities offer useful community contribution rather than only exposure?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; personal participation remains throughout.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Coordinate respectful outreach with community organisers
role.ambitious_version: An arranger who contributes to community life through personal presence.
